title.en: Which compact pumps print weights under 500 kg?
title.zh: 哪些紧凑泵的重量印在 500 kg 以下？

description.en: B500S-83D is 280 kg, Electric 10 Series is 400 kg, Electric 15 is 450 kg. The rural diesel is 800 kg and the 4100 is 1300 kg.
description.zh: B500S-83D 是 280 kg，电动10系列是 400 kg，电动15是 450 kg。农村柴油泵是 800 kg，4100 是 1300 kg。

h1.en: Which compact pumps print weights under 500 kg?
h1.zh: 哪些紧凑泵的重量印在 500 kg 以下？

directAnswer.en: Three electric compact rows from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai: B500S-83D at 280 kg, Electric 10 Series at 400 kg and Electric 15 at 450 kg. Weight does not replace the distance cell. B500S-83D is 5 m / 5 m. Electric 10 Series is 25 m horizontal and has no vertical cell. Electric 15 is 15–20 m vertical and 60–80 m horizontal. The 800 kg rural diesel and the 1300 kg 4100 are the off-grid compact pair, already above 500 kg.
directAnswer.zh: 邢台河北品锦机械的三行电动紧凑机：B500S-83D 280 kg，电动10系列 400 kg，电动15 450 kg。重量不能代替距离格。B500S-83D 是 5 m / 5 m。电动10系列是水平 25 m，没有垂直格。电动15是垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m。800 kg 的农村柴油泵和 1300 kg 的 4100 是无电网紧凑一对，已经超过 500 kg。

heading.en: Outline matters as much as mass

body.en: B500S-83D is 915 × 550 × 550 mm. Electric 10 Series is 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm. Electric 15 is 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm. A narrow plot that fits 550 mm width may not fit the 900 mm Electric 15 frame. That is a printed size check, not a measured doorway from a jobsite story.
body.zh: B500S-83D 是 915 × 550 × 550 mm。电动10系列是 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm。电动15是 1900 × 900 × 1200 mm。放得下 550 mm 宽度的窄地，不一定放得下 900 mm 的电动15机架。这是已印尺寸核对，不是某个工地的门洞故事。

heading.en: Under 500 kg still needs the right power
heading.zh: 500 kg 以下仍然要对电源

body.en: All three need electricity: 380 V on B500S-83D, and 15 kW motors on Electric 10 Series and Electric 15. No supply means the weight comparison moves to 800 kg and 1300 kg diesel or tractor units. Do not keep a sub-500 kg electric frame on a site that cannot feed it.
body.zh: 三台都要电：B500S-83D 要 380 V，电动10系列和电动15要 15 kW 电机。没有电源时，重量对照改到 800 kg 和 1300 kg 的柴油或拖拉机带动设备。现场供不起电时，不要留在 500 kg 以下的电动机架上。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send the width you can pass and the kilowatts or voltage you have. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发送能通过的宽度，以及你有的千瓦或电压。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Does 400 kg mean Electric 10 Series reaches as far as Electric 15?
question.zh: 400 kg 表示电动10系列和电动15一样远吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 25 m horizontal. Electric 15 prints 60–80 m horizontal.
answer.zh: 不是。电动10系列印水平 25 m。电动15印水平 60–80 m。

question.en: Are sprayer weights in this list?
question.zh: 喷涂机重量在这份名单里吗？

answer.en: No. This list is pumps. Type 311 at 150 kg and M9 at 200 kg are spraying machines.
answer.zh: 不在。这份名单是泵。150 kg 的 311 和 200 kg 的 M9 是喷涂机。
